title: Interactive Floor
shortDescription: A projected floor that reacts to every step, jump, and placed object, turning any open space into a game board, a discovery trail, or a living brand surface.
longDescription: An interactive projection on the floor that responds the moment visitors walk onto it. Steps trigger ripples and effects, jumps set off bursts, and placing an object on a marked spot can unlock content, so the floor becomes a playground, a guided story, or a product showcase. It can run open, ambient effects for passers-by, structured games with scores and levels, or a discovery path that reveals information stop by stop. Graphics, games, and content are fully configurable and scale from a small booth to a large hall. BRDGE handles the interaction logic, scene management, and journey, leaderboard, and data links end to end.

highlights.title: Step, Jump, Place
highlights.description: Visitors interact with their whole body: a step sends out ripples, a jump sets off a burst, and placing an object on the floor unlocks the next piece of content. No device, no instructions, just walk on.

highlights.title: From Booth Floor to Kids' Corner
highlights.description: The same floor works on a corporate stand, in a museum gallery, or in a family venue, so one module covers product demos, education, and pure play.

highlights.title: Game, Trail, or Arcade
highlights.description: Switch between scored reflex games with levels and points, a calm discovery path that reveals facts at each stop, or a full-floor arcade such as a giant pinball where players move the flippers with their feet.

highlights.title: Any Ground, Any World
highlights.description: Turn the floor into a Wild West trail map, a racing circuit where players choose their line, or an underwater reef full of hidden treasures, all on the same projection setup.

highlights.title: Footsteps Into Figures
highlights.description: Add a data layer that counts players, games started and finished, scores, and dwell time on the floor, so the client sees exactly how much traffic the space attracted and held.

highlights.title: The Floor That Connects
highlights.description: Pair with Visitor Identificator to save each player's score, with Live Feed to show the leaderboard on a wall screen, with Trail / Scavenger Hunt to make the floor one stop on a route, or with Memory Catcher to capture players mid-jump.
